name: Vale LS
description: Configurable prose style linting with Vale, exposed as a language server.
notes: Vale LS exposes Vale's configurable prose linting through LSP. It is designed for editorial style enforcement rather than general-purpose grammar. Vale requires a .vale.ini, a StylesPath, and a document to lint, so the Docker image ships a config at /workspace/.vale.ini with the proselint and write-good packages synced at build time; without a config no diagnostics are produced for any file type. The image also installs the Vale CLI on PATH, so installVale defaults to false and the server performs no downloads at startup. System mode builds the pinned Vale LS Git tag with Cargo and expects both a config and the Vale CLI on the host. Vale has no LaTeX parser: .tex is mapped to Markdown through a format association, with ignores for math and float environments so that equations do not produce spelling alerts.
author: TeXlyre
